QuestInfo.name: Calico Mack, the Pirate King
QuestInfo.0: Cassandra has something to say to you...
QuestInfo.1: Calico Mack, the Pirate King, was the scourge of the seas of Maple World. Cassandra will tell you more.
QuestInfo.2:
Eliminate Calico Mack, the scourge of the seas of Maple World, and take his treasure box!

#r<Recommended Areas>#k#b
Lv. 13-27: Golem's Temple
Lv. 28-39: Kerning Square 1st and 2nd Floors
Lv. 40-52: Garden of 3 Colors 2
Lv. 53-64: Korean Folk Town
Lv. 65-73: Boswell Field
Lv. 74-81: Sahel
Lv. 82-94: Magatia Alcadno Research Institute
Lv. 95-109: Red-Nose Pirate Den
Lv. 110-126: The Area of Kentaurus
Lv. 127-144: Dragon Forest
Lv. 145 or higher: Road of Regrets#k

0.0: Hey, #b#h0##k, have you heard of #rCalico Mack, the Pirate King#k? He was once the scourge of the seas of Maple World, with countless pirates under his command. But then, one day, he simply vanished. There have been many rumors about what happened to him...\n\nHowever, I think he has actually returned to Maple World. Would you like to hear the details?

no.0: Hmm... well, talk to me again if you DO get interested.

yes.0: Many have claimed to be Calico Mack in his absence, but recently, it would seem the real Pirate King has returned. It's just that he seems to be everywhere at once! Maybe while he was gone, he gained some kind of power...? Whatever the case, if you can catch him and defeat him, I'm sure you can score some amazing treasures!
yes.1:
Now, let me just warn you... #rYou cannot get a treasure chest from Calico Mack if the one you fight is at least 11 levels lower or 21 levels higher than you#k. With that in mind, there are specific places you can fight him.

#bLv. 13 - 27: Golem's Temple 
Lv. 28 - 39: Kerning Square 1st and 2nd Floors
Lv. 40 - 52: Garden of Three Colors 2
Lv. 53 - 64: Korean Folk Town
Lv. 65 - 73: Boswell Field
Lv. 74 - 81: Sahel Desert
Lv. 82 - 94: Magatia Alcadno Research Institute
Lv. 95 - 109: Red-Nose Pirate Den
Lv. 110 - 126: Kentaurus Area
Lv. 127 - 144: Dragon Forest
Lv. 145 and up: Road of Regrets#k

Now, those are just suggestions. As long as the Calico Mack you find is at the right level, it doesn't matter where you find him. You can see that list again in the #rquest completion window#k for Enter the Pirate King. All right then, good luck!

default.0: Hmm... I don't think you have what it takes to find the pirate king's treasure yet.
